generate_rearrange_episodes: generate rearrangement episodes using RearrangeEpisodeGenerator with a provided configuration file and scene settings
initialize_simulator: initialize a Habitat simulator with a selected scene and dataset for rearrangement tasks
sample_object_placements: sample object placements in a scene using configured object samplers and receptacle constraints
check_placement_stability: check the stability of object placements by running physics simulation for a specified duration
visualize_scene_receptacles: visualize scene receptacles with debug line representations and camera observations
